mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_ledger_entries (transfer_id, wallet_id, entry_type, amount, balance_after) VALUES (#{transferId}, #{walletId}, #{entryType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter})
mapper.select: SELECT e.transfer_id, t.transfer_type, e.entry_type, e.amount, e.balance_after, t.memo, e.created_at FROM wallet_ledger_entries e JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = e.transfer_id WHERE e.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: SELECT e.ledger_entry_id, e.transfer_id, t.transfer_type, e.entry_type, e.amount, e.balance_after, t.memo, e.created_at FROM wallet_ledger_entries e JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = e.transfer_id WHERE e.transfer_id = #{transferId} AND e.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT wo.owner_type, m.display_name, wo.system_code FROM wallet_ledger_entries e JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = e.wallet_id JOIN wallet_owners wo ON wo.wallet_owner_id = w.wallet_owner_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id = wo.member_id WHERE e.transfer_id = #{transferId} AND e.wallet_id != #{walletId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
